title: Marcoleta says 16-vote conviction threshold in Duterte impeachment trial should be fixed
summary: Sen. Rodante Marcoleta said Thursday he would not seek a furlough to vote on a proposed change to the 16-vote threshold required for conviction in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial.
